desc:
Webflow SEO and page speed optimization makes your site faster to load and clearer to search engines. Ecom Swift LLC fixes titles, headings, images, schema, sitemap and redirects inside your Webflow project, with a before and after speed report.

## What is Webflow SEO and speed optimization?

Webflow SEO and speed optimization is technical and on-page tuning of a Webflow site. It covers how pages are titled and described, how headings are ordered, how images are sized, which scripts load and how the site tells search engines what each page is about. The goal is cleaner, faster pages that both visitors and crawlers can understand.

Webflow produces tidy code by default, but the result depends on how a project is built. Heavy images, unused styles and missing metadata are common even on well-designed sites.

## Why speed and clarity matter together

A slow page loses visitors before they read anything, and a page that search engines cannot interpret rarely reaches the people looking for it. These two problems feed each other. Large images, extra fonts and stacked scripts slow loading, and unclear titles or headings make a page harder to match to a search.

Fixing them together is more effective than fixing one. A fast page with a vague title still struggles to be found. A well-described page that takes forever to load still frustrates the visitors it attracts.

## How the work affects visibility and enquiries

Search engines look at titles, headings, links, structured data and loading behavior to decide what a page is and who might want it. Clear titles and descriptions also appear in results, so they affect whether someone clicks. Schema markup helps engines identify things like organizations, articles and local businesses.

For visitors, quicker pages mean less waiting on phones and weaker connections. Layout that holds still while loading feels more trustworthy. We aim for cleaner, faster pages but cannot promise a ranking, because competitors, content quality and search engine changes all play a part.

## What a thorough optimization includes

- Unique page titles and meta descriptions on the pages that matter.
- Heading order corrected, with one clear main heading per page.
- Images compressed and resized, with useful alt text.
- Unused styles, scripts and fonts removed or reduced.
- Lazy loading applied where it helps.
- Schema markup on key pages, such as organization or article.
- Sitemap and robots settings checked.
- Redirects set up and 404 errors fixed.
- Search Console connected so you can see how the site is indexed.
- CMS template SEO fields set, so new items start with good metadata.

## How we work

We test your pages first and save the results so there is a clear starting point. Then we work through fixes in order of effect: page-level metadata, image weight, scripts and styles, structure and linking. Each change is made in your project and rechecked at the end for the before and after report.

The Basic package covers titles and meta for a handful of key pages, heading fixes, image compression, sitemap and robots checks and a speed report. The Standard package covers more pages and adds schema, removal of unused styles and scripts, lazy loading, font tuning, redirects, 404 fixes and Search Console setup. The Premium package reaches the whole site, adds a keyword map, CMS template fields, Core Web Vitals work, internal linking and a longer action plan. Extra pages, a blog post SEO template and local business schema are available as add-ons.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us which pages and search phrases matter most.
- Keep page titles specific and under a sensible length.
- Use real, descriptive alt text on meaningful images.
- Upload images at the size they will be displayed.
- Check Search Console after the work to watch for errors.

**Avoid:**
- Repeating the same keyword in every title.
- Changing page addresses without redirects.
- Adding scripts for features you do not use.
- Using several different font families.
- Expecting overnight results from any search work.

## Who this service is for

This service suits business owners whose site is slow, agencies handing off a finished build that needs a search pass and writers or shops with CMS content that needs consistent metadata. It also suits sites that were redesigned recently and never got a technical check.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, your priority pages and the search phrases you care about. We never need your password. We work as a collaborator in your Webflow project, and read-only access to analytics and Search Console helps if you can add us.
